svg.aria-label: \begin{aligned} \Gamma^0_{11} &=& {{a\dot a}\over{1-kr^2}}\qquad \Gamma^0_{22} = a\dot a r^2 \qquad \Gamma^0_{33} = a\dot a r^2\sin^2\theta\cr \Gamma^1_{01} &=& \Gamma^1_{10} = \Gamma^2_{02}= \Gamma^2_{20} = \Gamma^3_{03}= \Gamma^3_{30}={{\dot a}\over a}\cr \Gamma^1_{22} &=& -r(1-kr^2) \qquad \Gamma^1_{33} = -r(1-kr^2)\sin^2\theta\cr \Gamma^2_{12} &=& \Gamma^2_{21} = \Gamma^3_{13} = \Gamma^3_{31} = {1\over r}\cr \Gamma^2_{33} &=& -\sin\theta\,\cos\theta \qquad \Gamma^3_{23} = \Gamma^3_{32} = \cot\theta\ . \end{aligned} \tag{8.12}
